applies_why: The judge text resolves D3 vs C6 by treating the sign verse itself as lacking a stated mechanism rather than weighing the opposed chains by footing.
quote: the sign itself does not state the mechanism.
rule_words: When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.
room: never verse by verse — one reading requires chain-vs-chain footing and forbids deciding by whether one verse states the mechanism; the other permits underdetermination because the sign itself omits the mechanism.
why: Calling the link underdetermined because the sign itself does not state the mechanism is the verse-by-verse stating-verse approach K-C retires when the pressing witnesses are read together.
